card.name: Links before fluoroquinolone antibiotic names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right after or before a fluoroquinolone name (ciprofloxacin, ofloxacin, norfloxacin) in drug-interaction or warning text. Also fires on 'with' or 'of' in treatment-combination phrases.

modes.description: A comma or 'and' following ciprofloxacin or norfloxacin in a list of drugs.
